title: Tri-layered Electrospinning to Mimic Native Arterial Architecture using Polycaprolactone, Elastin, and Collagen: A Preliminary Study
protocol: Extract collagen from 6 month bovine corium using an acetic acid based process.
Purify the extracted collagen through dissolutions, precipitations, and dialyses.
Lyophilize purified collagen for electrospinning preparation.
Mass polycaprolactone (PCL), elastin (ELAS), and collagen (COL) according to requirements.
Dissolve PCL in HFP at a concentration of 100 mg/ml.
Dissolve ELAS in HFP at a concentration of 200 mg/ml.
Dissolve COL in HFP at a concentration of 70 mg/ml.

Blend materials in five different scintillation vials at volumetric ratios of 98-2-0 PCL-ELAS-COL (intima), 45-45-10, 55-35-10, and 65-25-10 PCL-ELAS-COL (media), and 70-0-30 PCL-ELAS-COL (adventitia).
Load polymer solutions into a plastic 3 ml Becton Dickinson syringe with an 18 gage blunt-tip needle.
Place the syringe onto a syringe pump set for dispensing rate.
Electrospin individual layers at a rate of 4 ml/hr and volume of 0.5 ml for intima layer.
Combine both intimal and medial syringes to transition for 0.2 ml at 2 ml/hr each.
Stop the intimal syringe, allow medial layer to spin for 0.6 ml at 4 ml/hr.
Transition between media and adventitia layers with 0.2 ml of polymer solution at 2 ml/hr each.
Allow adventitia layer to spin for 0.4 ml at 4 ml/hr.
Cross-link all samples in 50 mM EDC for 18 hours prior to testing.
Hydrate electrospun sheets in PBS for 24 hours.
Punch "dog-bone" shaped samples from hydrated electrospun mats.
Test samples on an MTS Bionix 200 testing system with a 100 N load cell and an extension rate of 10.0 mm/min.
Calculate peak stress, modulus, and strain at break using TestWorks version 4.
Soak tubular specimens in PBS for 24 hours at 37°C.
Place 5-0 commercial PDS II violet monofilament suture 2 mm from the end of each specimen.
Extend sutures until they pull through the graft on MTS Bionix 200 testing system with a 50 N load cell and an extension rate of 150.0 mm/min.
Record peak load in grams-force using TestWorks version 4.
Hydrate burst tubes from electrospun grafts in PBS.
Fit hydrated burst tubes over 1.5 mm diameter nipples attached to the device.
Secure burst tubes with 2-0 silk suture.
Introduce air into the system at a rate of 5 mmHg/s until tubes burst.
Report results as pressure in mmHg at which tubes ruptured.
